@@ -114,6 +118,28 @@ jobs:
         run: rustup show && cargo --version
       - name: Perf-regression gate
         run: cargo test --release
+      - name: Benchmark (canonical CI-stamped medians)
+        run: |
+          cargo bench --bench render -- \
+            --warm-up-time 1 --measurement-time 2 --sample-size 30 \
+            | tee bench-render.txt
+          {
+            echo "### Trussbars render benchmark — canonical CI medians"
+            echo ""
+            echo "Runner: \`${{ runner.os }}\` · ref \`${{ github.sha }}\`. Indicative (CI"
+            echo "runners are shared); the README table is a contributor-machine snapshot."
+            echo ""
+            echo '```'
+            grep -E 'time:' bench-render.txt || echo "(no medians captured)"
+            echo '```'
+          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
+      - name: Upload benchmark medians
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: trussbars-bench-render-medians
+          path: trussbars/benchmarks/bench-render.txt
+          if-no-files-found: warn
